items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I remember, oh I can't think of his name, not Oliver.

ctx.x: Did colored bands play straight music coming back? Did the colored bands play straight music or ragtime coming back? Do you remember?

Straight music. They did too? Yeah. I remember, oh I can't think of his name, not Oliver. Cutler's brother had a band. I remember his band because I heard his band play time and time again. See? And I had my band going on too, you know. My band was going on too. On the other side of the river? Vega, he used to show Vega too how to play. He used to have a finger in the corner. Who? Oh, this colored fellow. I can't think of his name now.
There was one man, the colored fellow had a band I heard of, Manuel Perez. Manuel Perez is a man. That's the man?
